title: Mini-Split 2 Year Review | COLD CLIMATE
summary: A Colorado owner reviews a $1,200 mini-split heating his garage after two years, including a 9°F day, and doubts it would suit a whole winter that cold.

assertions.quote: we got 90° roughly of air coming out of the mini split and it is it is right now 9° outside

verdicts.note: Many inexpensive inverter mini-splits are rated to operate below 5°F, though at reduced capacity.
Standard (non-cold-climate) mini-splits with rated HSPF around 9-10 were observed operating below 0 F, at lower efficiency than cold-climate models; the report does not address price.
